composition.note: Composition per Amendments 2 and 4: E-group is the honest pool-bounded yield; N3 yielded zero under the tightened v2 gates (untested class, disclosed); pool-context controls filled dynamically after the registered fixed list exhausted. See validation/audit_claimset_v2_preregistration.md.

cache_policy: Production caches as-is (cache/cache.db, 7-30 day TTLs by source). Degraded states are never cached by design. No cache clearing, pinning, or special treatment for the scored run.
health_requirements: Pool jobs referenced by job_id_hint resolvable via api.jobs_db in completed/awaiting_review state with persisted candidates files

rerun_allowance.note: Fresh single-use one-fix-one-rerun allowance for v2 (archive-only: re-scores the frozen raw archive, never re-executes audits). v1's allowance remains consumed forever and is unaffected.
